plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), Mathematics major requirements: MAT-118, 119, 204, 206, 220, 321, 480 (2 cr), plus three 300-level courses (38 cr total). This plan uses MAT-331, MAT-316, MAT-309 for the three 300-level courses. Course titles and prerequisites hand-transcribed 2026-09-30; semester sequence from catalog prerequisites (advisor should confirm). Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language + electives to 128.
